messages:
Anya: Quick sync — Gatekeeper cutover for Passport tenant is tomorrow morning (02:00 UTC). Milestone checklist: network, image sync, certs, canary plan. Any blockers?

Raj: Network team ran the ACL sweep. Customers' VPC peering + route53 delegation done. Firewall still needs outbound egress NAT for prometheus scraping — talking to infra-NAT owners. Pinged @Sam.

Sam: LT for NAT here. Can add a SNAT for the tenant's subnet, but need confirmation on allowed egress ranges. Also need to know if registry pull will go through our mirror or directly to dockerhub.

Tess: Customer (Passport) confirmed they won't allow direct internet egress — air-gapped mode. They expect image pulls from our offline mirror. Do we have image sync signed and staged?

Raj: Mirror sync completed for core images, but not for the optional telemetry image (collector:v2.1). I kicked an async job to push it to the offsite mirror; ETA 2 hrs. Also need to rotate the host CA cert on the gateway nodes — @Anya can you sign off on cert TTL?

Anya: Approve rotation TTL=90d. Ops-bot, can you create a canary job that deploys to 2 nodes only and runs smoke (health + write) tests?

ops-bot: Canary job created: gatekeeper-canary-passport-2026-03-18. Steps: deploy to nodes [gk-1, gk-2], run /health and write test, report back. YAML:
```yaml
job: canary
nodes: [gk-1, gk-2]
checks:
  - curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health
  - curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/write -d '{"k":"v"}'
``` 

Sam: Two quick asks before we run: 1) Are the KV cache persistence mounts available on gk-1/gk-2? 2) Do we have fallback model variants for memory pressure? If not, canaries risk OOMs.

Raj: gk-1/2 have ephemeral mounts but PVCs are provisioned and bound. KV mount path is /var/lib/gatekeeper/kv. Verified permissions. Fallback models: yes, gatekeeper-lite is available and will be used by the runtime when mem > 85%.

Tess: I'll coordinate with Passport for a quick acceptance window right after canary (30 min). Ask them to have their integration engineer online at T+40.

Anya: OK action list:
- Raj: confirm collector:v2.1 mirror push done (ETA 2h) — owner
- Raj: rotate host CA on gateway nodes (TTL=90d) — owner
- Sam: schedule canary job + watch OOMs — owner
- Tess: coordinate customer acceptance window — owner

Please reply with :thumbsup: when you have your task acked.

Raj: :thumbsup: collector push started, will post when done.

Sam: :thumbsup: scheduling canary for 01:30 UTC to give mirror time.

Tess: :thumbsup: told Passport to be on call at 02:15 UTC.

Anya: Thanks. If anything critical shows up, escalate in #incidents. Otherwise will proceed with cutover plan.

Sam: quick note — for smoke writes use header X-Client: redwood-canary to ensure write path uses test namespace.

ops-bot: Canary job completed: success on gk-1, gk-2. Health OK, write OK. Logs: /jobs/gatekeeper-canary-2026-03-18/logs. 

Raj: collector:v2.1 pushed to mirror and verified checksum. Host CA rotation scheduled for 01:45 UTC.

Anya: closing loop — proceeding to cutover at 02:00 UTC. Will post a short post-mortem if anything unexpected surfaces. :rocket:
